definition: עִוָּרוֺן noun [masculine] blindness ; — only in phrase (subject ׳ י ), smite ( הִכָּה ) with blindness: figurative of 'blind incapacity' ( Dr ) ׳ בְּע Deut 28:28 of smiting horses ׳ בַּע Zech 12:4 , i.e. with blind staggers , making them helplessly wild.
